hardware_gate.target_hardware: Fabricated physical silicon for arXiv:2611.18859 co-design & sensor-calibrated lab hardware baselines (#43)
hardware_gate.reason: arXiv:2611.18859 reports pre-silicon projections with no fabricated hardware artifacts available (arxiv_id_only_artifacts_unverified_offline); deterministic assumption audit & roofline envelope comparison ran on CPU

assumptions.pre_silicon_assumption: Co-designed ultra-narrow/custom operator graphs matched to fixed on-chip SRAM capacity
assumptions.lab_baseline_reality: Production models (Qwen3.8-27B, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash) require dynamic long-context KV and general-purpose serving

assumptions.pre_silicon_assumption: Aggressive ultra-low-bit arithmetic assumed lossless in latency/energy projections
assumptions.lab_baseline_reality: Sub-4-bit quantization degrades coding/agent accuracy unless independently verified on end tasks (#70, #80)

assumptions.pre_silicon_assumption: Idealized on-chip SRAM / wafer-scale bandwidth without host PCIe/RDMA/KV spillover penalties
assumptions.lab_baseline_reality: Physical accelerators face HBM3e/LPDDR5X/GDDR6X pin limits, controller overhead, and multi-chip fabric hops

assumptions.pre_silicon_assumption: Core-array energy/op extrapolated without board VRMs, HBM PHY, host CPU, cooling, or thermal throttling
assumptions.lab_baseline_reality: Lab measurements (#43) require calibrated board/wall power sensors, soak stability, and observed throttle counters

assumptions.pre_silicon_assumption: Analytical/RTL pre-silicon synthesis estimates without tapeout defect yield or clock-tree derating
assumptions.lab_baseline_reality: Physical silicon bring-up routinely shifts frequency, leakage, and usable SRAM capacity relative to pre-silicon models
